resources.string: MangaDex doesn’t let apps use a normal login yet. Instead, each account creates its own “personal API client” and logs in with it. You only do this once.

1. On mangadex.org, open Settings → API Clients.\n2. Create a client (any name). Some are approved at once; others wait for MangaDex staff.\n3. Copy its client ID and secret here, with your username and password.
Your session ended. Enter your password to log back in.
Your password is sent only to MangaDex and never stored. The app keeps an encrypted login token on this device.
MangaDex didn’t accept that username and password. If the account is new, confirm its email first.
The client ID or secret is wrong, or the client isn’t approved yet (check Settings → API Clients on MangaDex). A personal client only works for the account that created it.
Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
Couldn’t reach MangaDex. Check your connection.
